component.name: Uguisu
component.summary: Archive podcasts to a folder you own

description.p: Uguisu, a podcast downloader and archive manager by Suzora, subscribes to podcast feeds, downloads their episodes and keeps them in a plain, verifiable archive on disk. Every file is checked against its recorded hash, and nothing Uguisu archives is ever deleted by Uguisu.
The application runs the same server and interface as the standalone Uguisu binary, on a private loopback port, and the two can open the same data directory.
